test_launch_program: test the launch function that launches a Launchpad program using multiple processes as a test
run_launch_with_resources: run the launch function with local_resources to configure PythonProcess interpreters for program nodes
review_launch_cleanup: review the launch function's cleanup mechanism that terminates worker processes on test completion
summarize_launch_context: summarize how the launch function initializes launch context with TEST_MULTI_PROCESSING for all program nodes
refactor_launch_worker_manager: refactor the launch function to use worker_manager_v2 with kill_workers_upon_sigint and immediate termination
